description_sq:
Prona pozicionohet ne katin e dhjete te nje objekti te ndertuar ne vitin 2005 i cili ndodhet ne Blv. Bajram Curri perbale Kompleksit Delijorgji.
Organizohet ne koridor qe ben shperndarjen, ambient ndenje, ambient gatimi, dy dhoma gjumi, tualet me ndricim natyral dhe dy ballkone.
Apartamenti ka orientim jug dhe perendim qe e mundeson te kete ndricim natyral te plote dhe pamje te lire.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar dhe investimi eshte bere shume cilesor si, vetrata te reja me parmak mermeri te zi, sistem ngrohje-ftohje chiller i instaluar tavanor me tuba bakri, parket druri industrial i importuar nga Italia (vlera ne treg 100Euro/m2), tualeti me hidrosanitare te Porcelanozes, kendi Vip Saloti etj.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE BEHIND DELIJORGJI COMPLEX
description_en: The property is located on the tenth floor of a building built in 2005, which is located in Blvd. Bajram Curri opposite Delijorgji Complex. It is organized in a corridor that distributes it, a living room, a kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom with natural light and two balconies. The apartment has a south and west orientation, which allows it to have full natural lighting and a clear view. The apartment is sold furnished and the investment is very high-quality, such as new windows with black marble railings, heating-cooling system, installed ceiling chiller with copper pipes, industrial wooden parquet imported from Italy (market value 100 Euro/m2), toilet with hydrosanitary Porcelanoz, Vip Saloti corner, etc.
